brand.name: Landlight
brand.tagline: Light landing pages built with HTML and Tailwind: no framework, no extra weight.

footer.note: A static landing page template by Rqeim.

index.description: Landlight is a static landing page template built with HTML, Tailwind and Alpine: an HTML file per route, checked before publishing, a page per language.
index.title: Landlight — a landing page built in minutes

one.label: MPA
one.text: One HTML file per route: no router, no moving parts.

three.label: Alpine
three.text: Menus and forms without a whole reactivity bundle, loaded on that page alone.

two.label: Tailwind
two.text: Version four, with the design tokens in CSS instead of a config file.

hero.text: Landlight is not a framework: an HTML file per route, Tailwind for the styling, and Alpine only where you truly need it. Nothing stands between the visitor and your page.

four.text: bun run build writes a dist folder ready for any static host.
four.title: A static build

features.note: Everything one landing page needs, with no unused packages and no settings you forget.

one.text: Every page is its own HTML file, and components come in with one <include> line, so you read it as the visitor gets it.
one.title: HTML first

three.text: The mobile menu, the form and the small state live on the tag itself, not in a component file that splits looks from behaviour.
three.title: Alpine for interaction

features.title:
Lightness is not a slogan,
it is how the page is built.

two.text: The whole identity sits in app.css: colour, type and space. One token changes every page.
two.title: Tailwind v4

one.text: An HTML file in src/views becomes a full page at its route, with a copy in every language.
one.title: Write the page

three.text: The build checks the page before publishing, then you upload plain static files or put them behind any CDN.
three.title: Publish

how.title:
Three steps,
then a page on the internet.

two.text: Use the Tailwind utilities, and add a token to @theme when you need a colour of your own.
two.title: Style with tokens

cta.text: Start with one page and add only what you need. Nothing is built that you do not use.
cta.title: Ready for your first page?

contact.description: Talk to the Landlight team about your landing page: tell us who you serve and what the visitor should do, and we send a first draft before any payment.
contact.heading: Tell us about your page
contact.note: We usually answer within one working day. No marketing mail, and your details are never shared with a third party.
contact.text: Tell us what you do, who you serve and what the visitor should do, and we send a first draft of the page before any commitment.
contact.title: Contact | Landlight

privacy.description: Read what this Landlight site collects when you visit or contact us, how we use and protect it, and which rights you hold over your own data.
privacy.heading: Privacy policy
privacy.text: Browsing this site collects no personal data. Only your theme and language preferences are stored in your own browser and never sent to a server. When you write or call, we keep the message and what it contains to answer you.
privacy.title: Privacy policy | Landlight
privacy.useText: What you send is used to answer you and to deliver what we agree on, never for marketing and never sold. Visit statistics, if enabled, carry no personal identifiers.
